_what_this_is: The search behind `published_comparison`, at its real size. Smaller than alirocumab-lipid's 101 abstracts and larger than inclisiran's 10, and saying so is the same discipline as stating a denominator.
transport: PubMed E-utilities via the bio-research MCP server
query: (empagliflozin) AND (heart failure) AND (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title] OR pooled analysis[Title])
why_not_all_were_appraised: The 5 appraised were the highest-relevance records. THE REMAINING 125 WERE NOT READ. A synthesis pooling exactly EMPEROR-Reduced with EMPEROR-Preserved on this endpoint could exist among them; if one does, this comparison has missed it, and the headline finding below -- that this pairing is unreplicated -- is bounded by that.
no_included_study_table_was_read: NOT ONE of the five had its included-study list read. Trial sets below are INFERRED from abstract text, participant totals and search cut-off dates. Every check that rests on an inferred set says so in its own verdict.

appraised.why: empagliflozin alone, in heart failure, reporting the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for worsening heart failure -- the closest published match to this review's estimand
contains EMPEROR-Preserved and reports CV death or HHF, but class-wide and restricted to preserved/mildly reduced EF
network meta-analysis over T2D with heart failure; a different question, included so a reader can see it was considered
safety outcomes only -- serious adverse events, genital and urinary infection. No efficacy estimate for this endpoint
patient-level pooled analysis of two empagliflozin trials on LEFT VENTRICULAR REMODELING, not on the clinical composite. A Letter
